integrity: The proof is analytic. The accompanying finite verifier is a stress test of the constructions and lower-bound lemma, not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite paths and finite sequences; it does not enumerate all realizing colorings or extend to arbitrary trees. Originality searches reduce but cannot eliminate risk from unindexed terminology variants.
title: Exact sequence b-coloring thresholds for paths
